package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"

	_ "github.com/swaggo/swag"
	_ "github.com/swaggo/gin-swagger"
	_ "github.com/swaggo/files"
)

// scenario for repository_or_service_packages_import_docs_or_generator_annotations: Core business packages that depend on documentation-only tooling or generator-specific concerns.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Setting struct {
	ID    uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Key   string `gorm:"size:128;uniqueIndex"`
	Value string `gorm:"type:text"`
}

// @title Settings API
// @version 1.0
// @description Manage application configuration settings

type SettingsRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewSettingsRepo(db *gorm.DB) *SettingsRepo {
	return &SettingsRepo{db: db}
}

// GetByKey retrieves a setting by its key name.
// @Summary Get a setting
// @Tags settings
// @Param key path string true "Setting key"
// @Success 200 {object} Setting
// @Router /settings/{key} [get]
func (r *SettingsRepo) GetByKey(key string) (*Setting, error) {
	var setting Setting
	err := r.db.Where("key = ?", key).First(&setting).Error
	return &setting, err
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
